title: Beacon: Intent-Aware Safe Rollout for Optimize Recommendations
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver an 'Beacon' rollout orchestration that safely auto-applies Optimize recommendations (batching/caching configs) using intent-aware trials, shadow traffic scoring, and operator holdpoints. Beacon should reduce manual toil while guaranteeing rollbackable, observable changes for production workloads. This ticket covers design, implementation of the trial harness, policy evaluation engine, and operator approval matrix for gated rollouts.
technical_design: Beacon has three components: 1) Dry-run simulator that computes token-level cost deltas and quality proxies on historical traffic; 2) Shadow trial runner that executes Apply proposals in a non-destructive path (duplicate requests into sandboxed instances with KV cache behavior) and emits confidence signals; 3) Policy evaluator that aggregates statistical confidence, safety thresholds (latency, failure rate, hallucination proxy), and tenant constraints to make auto-apply decisions or escalate to human approval. Configs are represented as immutable 'proposal' objects with version, rationale, and revert-job auto-generated. All decisions and telemetry are emitted to the Console via new telemetry stream 'beacon.rollout.v1'. Implementation notes: reuse optimize-suggestions API, extend runtime to support sandboxed shadow execution with no writeback, and add a small state-machine service for staged timers and operator latches.
rollout_plan: 1) Canary phase: enable Beacon in 'observe-only' mode for a small set of internal tenants (5%) to validate shadow signal fidelity; 2) Simulated adoption: run dry-run on 10 days of historical traffic and compare predicted cost delta vs actual after manual enablement on a staging fleet; 3) Controlled auto-apply: open auto-apply for low-risk tenants using a 3-step gate (shadow pass -> soft canary -> hard canary) with automatic pause if safety signals breach; 4) Operator matrix: require single operator acknowledgement for low-risk, two for medium-risk, and optional legal review for high-risk; 5) Full scale: widen to all eligible tenants after 3 successful canaries and 48 hours of stability. Each gate creates a human-reviewable PR with diffs and revert job attached.
acceptance_criteria: Beacon emits shadow telemetry that matches production within 5% error on token-level cost estimates for three independent workloads
Automatic pause triggers when latency P95 increases by >=20% or error-rate increases by >=0.5% compared to baseline
Built-in revert job successfully rolls back a canary within 2 minutes end-to-end in test harness
Operator acknowledgement flow appears in Console with clear rationale, diffs, and a one-click approve/reject action
No user-requested rollback incidents from pilot tenants in a 7-day observation window
test_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluator scoring logic and threshold boundary conditions
Integration tests that run shadow traffic against sandboxed instances and validate no side-effects
Chaos test: simulate a kernel OOM in sandbox and assert fail-open semantics in Beacon's decision path
Canary e2e test where a fake tenant receives staged apply and automated revert executes on injected violation
Telemetry canary: ensure console dashboard surfaces beacon.rollout.v1 events within 30s of emission
monitoring_alerts: Alert BEACON::PAUSE when any active canary breaches latency or error thresholds
Alert BEACON::REVERT_FAILED when a revert job does not finish within configured window
SLO regression telemetry event when token-unit cost delta differs from projection by >10% for two consecutive hours
Operator-lag indicator if manual approvals queue length > 5 for more than 1 hour
migration_and_rollback: All proposals create an auto-generated revert job (immutable) at proposal creation time
Rollback executes in two phases: immediate traffic switchback + background cache invalidation sweep. Revert job is idempotent.
Database schema changes are additive; run migration in maintenance window if needed. Provide feature-flag to disable Beacon globally.
Post-rollback verification: run smoke tests for affected routes and compare token-cost/time metrics against snapshot saved before apply
